It preserves all 2,080 historical Alpha-v25 theorems and independently appends 58 original-kernel- and Lean-verified results: nine square-factor foundations, 23 complete positive primitive Pythagorean inverse/classification proofs, and 26 actual Fermat-four descent and boundary theorems. The complete 216-node certificate contains 558 actual proof edges. G077 and G078 are fully closed, including both leg orientations and every zero boundary; the first execution wave is complete.
